summary.text: Laurie Campbell is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Suzanne Miles.
A former Daviess County Public Schools employee and small business owner, she says her top priority is protecting and strengthening Kentucky's public schools.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Campbell graduated from Ballard High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisville in 1988.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a Louisville native who spent 10 years in managerial roles at National City before relocating to Owensboro more than 30 years ago.
She said she was active in nonprofit work, including Junior League and service as Daviess County CASA Board Chair, and served 19 years on a School-Based Decision Making Council.
She also said she worked 13 years for Daviess County Public Schools, and that she serves on the Daviess County Democratic Party Executive Committee.

Campbell said in the survey that she opposes diverting taxpayer dollars to private schools and favors fully funding public education, pre-K for all, smaller class sizes, and higher teacher and staff pay.
She also listed raising wages, protecting Medicaid, modernizing family leave, and affordable childcare and housing among her priorities.
